rule: Use public papers/code/features only; no proprietary extraction.
Patient/source/HLA/peptide-cluster splits are separate required reports.
Sparse features such as TCR availability cannot dominate without ablation.
No primitive family can exceed a prespecified weight cap in claim-safe mode.
GA/RL gains must beat fixed ensemble and random search under same budget.
Prospective claims require locked score before v6 wetlab results.
Every modality branch needs missingness and availability stratification.
Report search generations, population, model count and CPU/GPU budget.
